about.title: About COGNITIO
about.subtitle: Neuroscience, music and memorization
about.summary_text: COGNITIO is an online platform that transforms study materials into educational songs using AI. It's built on a neuroscience-validated principle: music activates brain areas linked to long-term memory, and the natural repetition of a song creates a spaced revision effect — without conscious effort. COGNITIO is a complementary tool, designed to amplify your revision, not replace it.
about.science1_desc: Research in neuroscience (McGill University, 2014; Pereira et al., Journal of Neuroscience) shows that music simultaneously activates the hippocampus, prefrontal cortex, and auditory cortex — the same regions involved in long-term memory consolidation.
about.science2_desc: Everyone has memorized song lyrics without trying, simply from hearing them repeatedly. That's the core mechanism of COGNITIO: music naturally creates loops of content re-exposure.
about.science3_desc: Unlike reading or flashcards, listening requires no visual focus or sitting down. You can listen to your educational songs while walking, commuting, exercising, or cooking.
about.science4_desc: COGNITIO doesn't claim to replace deep reading, exercises, or lectures. Its role is to come after your first contact with the material, consolidating neural connections through musical repetition.
about.mission_text: Give every student a complementary revision tool, grounded in cognitive science and musical neuroscience research, that transforms any course material into a memorable musical experience.
about.how_step1: Upload your notes — Paste text, import a PDF, or take a photo of your handwritten notes.
about.how_step2: Choose a music style — 30 genres available: rap, lo-fi, pop, jazz, rock, EDM, afrobeat, K-pop, and many more.
about.how_step3: AI generates the lyrics — Educational lyrics structured around the key concepts of your notes.
about.how_step4: Listen anywhere, anytime — While commuting, walking, or exercising.
about.how_step5: Test yourself with the quiz — A 10-question MCQ is auto-generated.
about.value1_desc: Every feature is designed to maximize memorization. No useless gimmicks.
about.value2_desc: Education should be accessible to all. COGNITIO is adapted to all fields of study.
about.value3_desc: AI as a pedagogical lever, not a shortcut. The goal is to help understand and retain.
about.value4_desc: COGNITIO evolves based on user feedback and the student community.
about.contact_text: Don't hesitate to contact us for any questions, suggestions, or partnerships.
about.founder_bio: Emergency physician and innovation enthusiast, Laëticia founded COGNITIO to address a simple observation: medical students spend hours rereading without retaining. By combining neuroscience and AI-powered music, she created a tool that turns idle time into revision time.
